title: Stationarity for smooth compactly supported fields extends to C¹ fields (parent step 8)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold with H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. For a map Y : ℝ^P → ℝ^P put div_M Y(x) := trace(P_x ∘ DY(x)), P_x := span(tangentSpace M x).starProjection. Suppose ∫_M div_M Z dH^m = 0 for every C^∞ map Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport Z ⊆ U. Then ∫_M div_M X dH^m = 0 for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U (Bochner integrals for H^m = μHE[m] restricted to M).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ Z x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0
